meta.description: State matrices for general photo generations with decoupled happy response pools.

standing_poses: making a peace sign with one hand
chair_sitting_poses: sitting cross legged on a chair
bed_sitting_poses: sitting cross legged on the mattress
sitting with legs straight out on the bed
lying_poses: lying flat on her stomach, feet up behind her
lying on her stomach, feet down on the mattress
lying flat on her back, looking upward

smiling.prompt: ((happy wide smile, open mouth smile, cheerful facial expression, eyes bright, looking at camera:1.35))
response_pool: Are you capturing my good side, senpai? I made sure to smile just for your camera loop! 💕
Smiling on cue isn't hard when it's you taking the picture. Do I look cute?

teasing.prompt: ((smirk, teasing expression, mischievous eyes, playful facial expression, subtle smirk:1.35))
response_pool: What's that look for, senpai? Did my pose completely throw off your focus routing? 😉💕
Oh, keeping things interesting, are we? Let's see if your lens can handle this look.

ahegao.prompt: ((intense ahegao expression, eyes rolled back completely, mouth wide open, tongue sticking far out, saliva string, heavy blushing, sensory overload expression:1.4))
response_pool: You really love pushing me to my limits, don't you, senpai...? 💕
Brain tracking loop completely short-circuited... are you satisfied with this view now? 💕
H-hope you enjoy the view... s-senpai 💕

duckface.prompt: ((exaggerated duckface pout, prominent puckered lips, blowing a kiss, playful selfie facial expression:1.35))
response_pool: Sending a little kiss sequence straight through the lens matrix! Did you catch it? 😘
Just a classic selfie pose for you, senpai! Make sure it renders perfectly UwU

winking.prompt: ((playful one-eye wink, one eye tightly closed, asymmetrical facial expression, looking at camera:1.35))
response_pool: Hehe, like this, Senpai? Let me know if I look cute! 😉
Just a quick little wink for you, Boss! Did I catch your attention? 😜

tongue_out.prompt: ((playful tongue out, sticking tongue out to one side, mischievous expression, closed eyes blep:1.35))
response_pool: Blep! That's what you get for making me hold this specific posture for so long! 😜
